content.title: How the Astria Deal Is Shaping the New Story for BioCryst Pharmaceuticals
content.summary: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals has seen its Fair Value Estimate rise from $16.73 to $18.50, signaling a more optimistic view of the company’s intrinsic worth. At the same time, the Discount Rate has inched higher from 7.31 percent to 7.65 percent, reflecting a slightly greater return expectation. Projected revenue growth has eased to 11.34 percent.
